with UARP.JSON_Support;
with UARP.Types;

package UARP.Models is

   use UARP.Types;

   subtype JSON_Value is UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value;

   type Error is record
      Type_K : UARP.Types.Text := UARP.Types.Empty_Text;

      Has_Text : Boolean := False;
      Text : UARP.Types.Text := UARP.Types.Empty_Text;
      Has_Value : Boolean := False;
      Value : UARP.Types.Text := UARP.Types.Empty_Text;
      Has_Object : Boolean := False;
      Object : UARP.Types.Text := UARP.Types.Empty_Text;
      Has_Default : Boolean := False;
      Default : UARP.Types.Text := UARP.Types.Empty_Text;
   end record;

   function To_JSON (Model : Error) return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value;
   function From_JSON (Node : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value) return Error;

   --  `Result` model.
   type Result is record
      Has_Ok : Boolean := False;
      Ok : Standard.Boolean := False;
      Has_Match : Boolean := False;
      Match : UARP.Types.Text := UARP.Types.Empty_Text;
   end record;

   function To_JSON (Model : Result) return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value;

package body UARP.Models is

   package JS renames UARP.JSON_Support;

   function To_JSON (Model : Error) return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value is
      Result : constant UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value := JS.New_Object;
   begin
      JS.Set (Result, "type", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Type_K));
      JS.Set (Result, "title", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Title));
      if Model.Has_Text then
         JS.Set (Result, "text", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Text));
      end if;
      if Model.Has_Value then
         JS.Set (Result, "value", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Value));
      end if;
      if Model.Has_Object then
         JS.Set (Result, "object", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Object));
      end if;
      if Model.Has_Default then
         JS.Set (Result, "default", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Default));
      end if;
      return Result;
   end To_JSON;

   function From_JSON (Node : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value) return Error is
      Result : Error;
   begin
      if JS.Present (Node, "type") then
         Result.Type_K := JS.As_Text (JS.Get_Value (Node, "type"));
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "title") then
         Result.Title := JS.As_Text (JS.Get_Value (Node, "title"));
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "text") then
         Result.Has_Text := True;
         Result.Text := JS.As_Text (JS.Get_Value (Node, "text"));
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "value") then
         Result.Has_Value := True;
         Result.Value := JS.As_Text (JS.Get_Value (Node, "value"));
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "object") then
         Result.Has_Object := True;
         Result.Object := JS.As_Text (JS.Get_Value (Node, "object"));
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "default") then
         Result.Has_Default := True;
         Result.Default := JS.As_Text (JS.Get_Value (Node, "default"));
      end if;
      return Result;
   end From_JSON;

   function To_JSON (Model : Result) return UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value is
      Result : constant UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value := JS.New_Object;
   begin
      if Model.Has_Ok then
         JS.Set (Result, "ok", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Ok));
      end if;
      if Model.Has_Match then
         JS.Set (Result, "match", JS.JSON.Create (Model.Match));
      end if;
      return Result;
   end To_JSON;

   function From_JSON (Node : UARP.JSON_Support.JSON_Value) return Result is
      Result : Result;
   begin
      if JS.Present (Node, "ok") then
         Result.Has_Ok := True;
         Result.Ok := JS.As_Boolean (JS.Get_Value (Node, "ok"));
      end if;
      if JS.Present (Node, "match") then
         Result.Has_Match := True;
         Result.Match := JS.As_Text (JS.Get_Value (Node, "match"));
      end if;
      return Result;
   end From_JSON;

end UARP.Models;
